title: CULTURALFRAMES: Assessing Cultural Expectation Alignment in Text-to-Image Models and Evaluation Metrics
reasoning: The paper introduces CULTURALFRAMES, a benchmark where 'religion' is one of the five primary socio-cultural domains evaluated. It specifically tests model alignment with both explicit and implicit expectations regarding religious rituals, customs, and sacred elements across multiple cultures, such as Hindu weddings, Jain temple practices, and Islamic prayer.
